title: Record that length-4 G20 conjugations do not emit after one moved cor…
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped negative result. No κ change and no selected-frontier update. The selected record stays κ = 781451/250000000 from PR #6030, with the five framework assumptions still in force.

On the emitted local word of PR #5708, every length-4 A2 conjugation keeps its scalar endpoint when exactly one of its four corrections is moved onto a different frame of the published one-edge route table. All 302,260 such assignments fail to emit: 301,756 fail at the contact-correction meeting, and 504 meet and then miss a later published edge. No assignment lowers the paid-query moment on (0, 1).

The contact-frame slice of the same 119 intervals is 118 missing routes and one unchanged histogram, at zero-based scalar positions 9,399 and 10,815 of ADD(560, 315). A control recount of all 1,503 lengths of four or more at the contact frame matches the published #6305 totals (1,450 missing, 14 unchanged, 39 strict losses). That control does not replace the #6305 proof.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Task card `bit-helper-contract`, catalogue revision 8. Scope status: **refined**. The card says to review the #5679/#5708 chain and stop when a proposed cut does not improve the paid moment. This package is the length-4 one-move clause left open by the length-1..3 moved-frame screen.

Ordered eligible list for session r89. The revision-8 "Next bounded decisions" table is the list, followed by catalogue cards not named there. Item #2 is BIT (`bit-helper-contract`). The length-1..3 one-move result is already on main, so the distinct remaining piece is length 4 with one moved correction.

Nearest work:

- PR #6305 keeps every correction on its contact frame for length 4 and above.
- PR #6337 moves one correction only for lengths 1..3.
- `research/g20-one-contact-free-frame` allows catalogue paths, and only for one contact.
- `research/g20-neutral-two-step-obstruction` keeps correction frames fixed.
- No open PR replays this length-4 one-move domain.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library only. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/g20-length4-moved-frame/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/g20-length4-moved-frame/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-length4-moved-frame --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-length4-moved-frame
```

Observed markers: `PASS_G20_LENGTH4_MOVED_FRAME` with `intervals=119`, `moved_assignments=302260`, `local_fail=301756`, `local_feasible=504`, `missing_edge=504`, `emitted=0`, `savings=0`, `long_control=1503/1450/14/39`, then `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. `check_research_commit.py` printed `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` at head `2ca0030166f85a833da2a3eb66a0bf82ac3dfe1c`. Checks raise exceptions, so `-O` does not disable them.

Not run: the #5708 integration replay, the 18-call caller, adjoint columns, moduli 101 and 10201, ordinary admission, Lean, Docker, `make frontier6030-verify`, and `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` (this checkout's upstream history is shallow). `python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py` printed `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`. That is binding orientation only.

## Credit

The emitted word, route table, and A2 relation are Ali Romman's `research/g20-conjugation-admission`, following Dugongue, ai-nanachi, and the retained G20 lineage named there. The length-1..3 contact-frame census is unpaidmoon's #6290. The length-4-and-above contact-frame obstruction is Nick Petalas's #6305. The length-1..3 one-move obstruction is unpaidmoon's #6337. The one-contact free-frame obstruction and the fixed-frame neutral two-step obstruction are separate packages and are not imported.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can two corrections in one length-2, length-3 or length-4 interval lower the paid moment when both frames move? First step: one two-move pair on this word and route table. No saving seed is supplied.
2. Can one moved correction at length 5 or more lower the paid moment? #6305 excludes those lengths only at the contact frame. First step: one length-5 interval with one moved frame.
3. Do the six neutral one-step neighbors and the 645 common-frame expansions in the #5708 README have an executable rule? Blocked by the missing search record in that package.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The predecessor package named the length-4 one-move clause as an open question, which made the overlap boundary clear. A link to discussion #1200 is enough; no separate session report.
